body:
Barbiturate are nothing I know much of. I took three of the 30 pills I got from a legit source however and all this changed.
For one thing, much more than pain killers, it relaxed, affirmed, calmed me. So calm so serene is the feeling I would describe it as 'bliss.' 40-45 minutes after consuming three pills I began a calm euphoric high trip. I liked it. I have never been okay to that point with everything before from any pill or any mind exercise, this is a good thing. Music movies and a general 'okayness' with everything prevailed, I felt a slight emotional sentimental awe with this high.
